contract.title: SOC Dashboard Visual Parity - Rework 16
acceptance_criteria: Only Rework 16 is executable and only the exact four allowed paths may change; all component logic, Registry, routing, layout, workspace content, backend, provider, data and runtime paths remain unchanged.
Sidebar navigation item text uses exactly 14px and Sidebar section headings use exactly 13px with font weight 600.
The closed WorkspaceSwitcher uses exactly 14px with font weight 600 while retaining its existing height, padding, background, border, Chevron, pointer, hover and focus-visible affordances.
Workspace dropdown items use exactly 13px and dropdown section labels use exactly 11px with font weight 600 while remaining visually subordinate to the workspace entries.
Focused Sidebar and Topbar CSS-contract tests assert the exact typography values and retain the existing 164px Sidebar width and min-width assertions.
The Rework 15 SOC, Management and System Administration grouping, exact membership and order, two dividers, Purple selected state, aria-current and visible checkmark remain unchanged.
workspaceRegistry remains the central display-name source; CISO / ISO, WorkspaceId.EXECUTIVE, the /executive route and the canonical setWorkspace and navigate boundary remain unchanged.
The real / to /executive to / cross-workspace flow, correct Sidebar and current-workspace identity, Back and Forward and URL authority remain passing.

The Rework 14 Sidebar cascade fix remains intact with width and min-width 164px and no global legacy override, important rule, specificity workaround, negative margin, transform or offset compensation.
Existing PlatformLayout, SOC Dashboard, Explainability and Executive behavior and all Rework 10 through 15 preservation gates remain passing.
Focused Sidebar and Topbar tests, WorkspaceSwitcher grouping and cross-workspace tests and existing Sidebar, PlatformLayout, SOC, Explainability and Executive regressions pass.
The full frontend regression, TypeScript, production build and git diff --check pass and Scope Guard confirms only the exact four authorized paths changed.
The immutable visual reference remains unchanged with SHA-256 af672a97050c5e535199d8d006012cf000e5e7b9b66693a02817c4356eea80df.
Product Owner Live Acceptance remains mandatory at 1536 x 1024 and 100 percent zoom for Sidebar and WorkspaceSwitcher readability, all grouped menu states and continued Sidebar Main geometry.
Do not claim Product Owner PASS, transition TASK-0122 to DONE or create TASK-0123.
